levels.title: JAVA 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: Java 21 utility classes should be declared final with a private constructor, 4-space indentation, complete Javadoc (@param/@return), and Math.addExact() against overflow.
levels.starter_code: public class Calc{public static int add(int a,int b){return a+b;}}

remedial_drills.title: Syntax Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Fix the syntax error so the snippet parses cleanly.
remedial_drills.starter_code: public int id(int x) { return x }
remedial_drills.solution_hint: End the return statement with a semicolon `;`.

remedial_drills.title: Edge-Case Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Add the defensive guard to prevent runtime failures.

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.
remedial_drills.starter_code: public int sum(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

keywords_glossary.role: Prevents subclassing and accidental instantiation of static utility classes.
Throws ArithmeticException on integer overflow instead of silently wrapping to a negative number.
Documents parameters and return contract using official Javadoc tags.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 4 spaces for class members and 8 spaces inside method bodies.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Compact private constructor first, blank line, then Javadoc above the static method.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Same-line opening braces (Java K&R) and semicolons terminating statements.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Javadoc /** ... */ on both the class and the public method with @param and @return.

analogous_example.title: Overflow-safe multiplication utility class with Math.multiplyExact
analogous_example.why_it_works: Uses a final class, private constructor, 4-space indentation, and exact arithmetic.

levels.title: JAVA 2 · Edge Cases & Documentation
levels.concept_capsule: Java 21 records eliminate immutable class boilerplate and enforce non-null invariants inside a compact constructor via Objects.requireNonNull().
levels.starter_code: public class User{private final String email;public User(String email){this.email=email;}public String email(){return email;}}

tests.name: Null validation
tests.description: Validates non-null email in compact constructor

remedial_drills.title: Syntax Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Fix the syntax error so the snippet parses cleanly.
remedial_drills.starter_code: public record Point(int x int y) {}
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Separate record components with a comma.

remedial_drills.title: Edge-Case Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Add the defensive guard to prevent runtime failures.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Validate null inputs in the compact constructor.

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Add Javadoc above the public record.

keywords_glossary.role: Automatically synthesizes final fields, canonical constructor, email() accessor, equals, hashCode, and toString.
Validates record components without repeating parameter lists or manual field assignments.
Fails fast with a clear NullPointerException message when null is passed.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 4 spaces for the compact constructor and 8 spaces for Objects.requireNonNull.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: import java.util.Objects at top, blank line, Javadoc with @param, then the record body.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: No parameter parentheses on the compact constructor header public User { ... }.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Javadoc /** ... */ above the record documenting each component via @param.

analogous_example.title: Immutable Sku record with compact constructor validation
analogous_example.why_it_works: Replaces verbose POJO boilerplate with a record and guards against null via Objects.requireNonNull.
